notes.subject: dikubita tsa aletare
notes.rationale: Seterekeng sena ho balwa dipalo tse hlakileng: diama tse pedi, e le nngwe, tse nne, e le nngwe — mepeho ya aletare.

notes.subject: חיק
notes.rationale: 'Sehube' (mocheso/khamuhle) kgahlanong le 'motheo' (KJV) kapa 'moqopi' (BSB); peo e bolokilwe ka ho ea ka sebopeho sa yona.

notes.subject: עזרה
notes.rationale: Liphetolelo li fapana: 'teratere' (border/ledge), 'settle' (KJV), 'mothathelesi' — lentsoe le bolela sekwere se koahetseng, eseng boapelele ba tempele.

notes.subject: e tla ba
notes.rationale: Seheberu se se na sephoso; palo e hlakile, sephoso se fane ka ponahalo ea tlhaho ea Sesotho.

translation: Mme ho tloha sehubeng sa lefatshe ho fihlela ho ⟨את⟩ teratere ya ka tlase, e tla ba diama tse pedi, mme bophara bo le boima ba ama e le nngwe; mme ho tloha ho ⟨את⟩ teratere e nyenyane ho fihlela ho ⟨את⟩ teratere e kgolo, diama tse nne, mme bophara ba ama.
